state_space: continuous virtual latent coordinates generated by actions (no coordinate graph, not cells)
start: Regulatory T centroid = mean Z of Regulatory T cells
actions: +/- each of 16 latent axes x strides [1] = 32
base_substep: 0.01 x observed SD per latent axis
support_constraint: every sub-step 5th-NN distance <= 0.251656 (q0.95); next decoded FOXP3 >= 0; decrease > 8*dtype_epsilon*max(abs(current_FOXP3),1)
entropy_role: observational state feature, CSV and visualization only; not reward
training_terminal: 500-move horizon or no supported FOXP3-decreasing action; no stagnation stop
entropy: Shannon H of decoded expression p=expm1(max(decoder(z),0))/sum (nats)

stop_rule.rule: ||(z_t - z_(t-patience)) / SD|| <= min_net_displacement for t >= patience (little or no movement)

clustering.method: Ward hierarchical on 3-phase net latent displacement (observed-SD units)
clustering.k_selection: silhouette elbow: largest k before the silhouette drops by > 0.1 (else first k with next gain < 0.25 x largest gain)

interpretation: Fixed-VAE model trajectories, not causal KO or validated differentiation.
